Title: Register valid General User
Steps: 1. Open /account (Register tab) 2. Choose General User 3. Enter data 4. Submit
Test data: name=QA Test User; email=m3.user@example.test; password=TestPassword123!; phone=0771234567; district=Colombo
Expected result: 201 / session created; redirected to dashboard; logging out and logging in again succeeds
Actual result: Registered a new General User; POST /api/auth/register returned 201 and the dashboard (Hello, QA) opened with a session. The same account (m3.user@example.test) is used for the wrong-password login in F02.

Title: Login with wrong password
Preconditions: Account from F01 exists (use a password of 8+ chars: shorter ones fail validation with 422 before the credential check)
Steps: 1. Open login 2. Enter correct email, wrong password 3. Submit
Expected result: 401 'Email or password is incorrect.'; no session; stays on login page
Actual result: Login with a correct email and wrong password (8+ chars) returned 401 "Email or password is incorrect."; no session created; login page remained.

Title: Create pickup with quantity 0
Steps: 1. Open New pickup 2. Fill valid data with quantity 0 3. Submit
Test data: quantity=0; other fields valid (category=laptops, district=Colombo, future date)
Expected result: 422; message 'Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 999.'; nothing created
Actual result: Browser form check blocked quantity 0 ("Value must be greater than or equal to 1."). With the form check bypassed, POST /api/pickups returned 422 "Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 999." with field error on quantity; nothing created.

Title: Edit own pending request
Steps: 1. Open My requests 2. Open pending request 3. Edit itemName 4. Save
Expected result: 200; new name shown; version (__v) increments by 1
Actual result: PATCH returned 200; item name changed to "QA test laptop (edited)"; __v incremented from 0 to 1.

Title: Delete own pending request
Steps: 1. Open pending request 2. Delete 3. Confirm dialog
Expected result: 204; request disappears from list; opening its URL shows not found
Actual result: DELETE returned 204; the request disappeared and My requests shows 1 request. (Deleted request was the quantity-999 pickup from F09.)

Title: Edit accepted pickup
Preconditions: Pickup accepted by collector (do F07 first)
Steps: 1. As owner open accepted request 2. Try to edit/save (UI may hide the edit button - then replay PATCH via Postman with current __v)
Expected result: 409 'This request has changed or is no longer pending...'; request unchanged
Actual result: As owner, PATCH on the pickup already accepted by the collector returned 409 (Conflict); the request still shows Accepted and is unchanged. Owner page also shows the assigned collector.

Title: Collector accepts pending pickup
Preconditions: Pending pickup exists; collector account logged in
Steps: 1. Collector dashboard > Available 2. Open pickup 3. Accept
Expected result: 200; status becomes accepted; collector assigned; timeline has 'accepted' entry
Actual result: Collector accepted the pending pickup; status became accepted; collector assigned; timeline shows an "accepted" entry.

Title: Quantity upper boundary 1000
Steps: 1. New pickup 2. quantity 1000 3. Submit
Expected result: 422 quantity error; nothing created
Actual result: Quantity 1000 submitted (form check bypassed). Server returned 422; field error "Enter a whole number from 1 to 999." shown; nothing created.

Title: Quantity valid boundaries 1 and 999
Steps: 1. Create pickup with quantity 1 2. Create another with quantity 999
Expected result: 201 for both; saved quantity shown correctly; delete both afterwards
Actual result: Quantity 1 created (201), page shows "1 item". Quantity 999 created (201), page shows Quantity 999. The 999 request was deleted afterwards (see F05); the quantity-1 request was kept for F04, F06 and F07.

Title: itemName length boundaries
Steps: 1. Create with itemName of length 1 2. length 2 3. length 120 4. length 121 5. '  a ' (padded)
Actual result: Console table: length 1 -> 422; 2 -> 201; 120 -> 201; 121 -> 422; "  a " (trims to 1) -> 422. All matched expected; test items deleted.

Title: Invalid category
Steps: 1. Use Postman POST /api/pickups with category not in list (UI uses a dropdown)
Expected result: 422 'Choose a valid category.'
Actual result: Invalid category returned 422 "Choose a valid category."; nothing created.

Title: Registration with invalid email / short password
Steps: 1. Register with email 'abc@' 2. Register with valid email and 7-char password
Expected result: 422 'Enter a valid email address.' / 422 password message; no account created
Actual result: Email "abc@" returned 422 "Enter a valid email address."; 7-character password returned 422 password-length message; no account created.

Title: Required fields empty
Steps: 1. Leave city and address empty 2. Submit
Expected result: 422; error for the first invalid field only (city is checked before address); nothing created
Actual result: Empty city and address: POST /api/pickups returned 422 with banner "Check city." and field error "Enter 2-100 characters." - only the first invalid field (city) is reported; nothing created.

Title: Past and malformed preferredDate
Steps: 1. Submit with yesterday 2. Submit with 2026-02-30 3. Submit with 23/12/2026
Expected result: 422 'Pickup dates cannot be in the past.' / 'Choose a valid pickup date.'; today and future date accepted (re-check with a valid date)
Actual result: Console table: yesterday -> 422; 23/12/2026 -> 422; 2026-02-30 -> 422; "abc" -> 422; today -> 201 (test pickup deleted). All matched expected.

Title: Duplicate account registration
Steps: 1. Register again with the same email (also try different letter case)
Expected result: 409 'An account with this email already exists.'; no second account
Actual result: Registering an existing email returned 409 "An account with this email already exists."; no second account created.

Title: Logout ends session
Steps: 1. Click Logout 2. Press browser Back 3. Open /dashboard (or GET /api/auth/me with old cookie)
Expected result: 204; protected pages redirect to login; API returns 401
Actual result: Logout returned 204 and the login page opened; GET /api/auth/me afterwards returned 401 {"message":"Please log in to continue."}.

Title: Role enforcement
Preconditions: One user and one collector account
Steps: 1. As collector POST /api/pickups 2. As user GET /api/pickups?scope=available
Expected result: Collector create -> 403 role message; user 'available' list -> 403
Actual result: Collector POST /api/pickups returned 403 "This action is not available for your account role."; user GET /api/pickups?scope=available returned 403 "Only collectors can browse available requests."

Title: Another user's pickup is not accessible
Preconditions: Pickup owned by user A; user B logged in
Steps: 1. As B open /api/pickups/<A id> 2. As B PATCH it 3. As B DELETE it
Expected result: GET -> 404; PATCH -> 409; DELETE -> 409; A's pickup unchanged
Actual result: Logged in as another user (m1.user@example.test): GET returned 404 "Pickup request not found."; PATCH returned 409 "This request has changed or is no longer pending..."; DELETE returned 409 "Only your own pending requests can be deleted...". Owner's pickup remained Pending and unchanged.

Title: Search, filter and pagination
Steps: 1. Search 'laptop' 2. Filter status=pending 3. Filter district=Galle 4. limit=5&page=2 5. Search with regex chars '.*'
Expected result: Results match filters; total/pages consistent; page 2 has the remaining rows; '.*' treated literally (no match or literal match), no error 500
Actual result: Console table (test pickups named 'search'): search total 7; district=Galle total 2; limit=5 page 1 count 5 and 2 pages; page 2 count 2; status=accepted 0; status=pending 7; q=.* matched 0 (treated literally, no 500); invalid scope returned 422. All PASS; 7 test pickups deleted.

Title: Photo count limit
Preconditions: Logged in as General User; 4 valid JPG/PNG/WebP files under 2 MB
Steps: 1. Attach 3 photos and save 2. Try to add a 4th
Expected result: 3 photos saved; 4th blocked in UI (or API 422 'Choose up to three photos per pickup request.')
Actual result: API check: 3 photos -> 201 and 3 photos saved; 4 photos -> 422 "Choose up to three photos per pickup request." Saved request shows 3 photos and the edit page shows "3 of 3 photos selected".
